candidate_descriptions.r2_vwap_trend: 15m session HLC3-volume VWAP recross, with latest completed 4h EMA50/100 direction and close beyond EMA100; 1.5x15m ATR14 stop, 2.5R target, maximum32 bars (8h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_vwap_fade: Latest completed-hour ADX14<18; 15m close re-enters session VWAP +/-2 volume-weighted SD, comparing prior close/prior band and current close/current band; 1.5x15m ATR14 stop, frozen VWAP target requiring>=1.5R, maximum16 bars (4h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_rsi2_exhaustion: Completed-hour RSI2 first crosses below5 with latest completed4h close>EMA100 (long), or above95 with4h close<EMA100 (short); 2xhourly ATR14 stop, frozen hourly SMA5 target requiring>=1R, maximum48 bars (12h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_shock_reversal: Previous completed hour has abs(close-open)>=3xATR14 from the hour before it and volume>=2xmedian of20 prior hours excluding shock; current hour has opposite candle color and closes above shock close for long/below shock close for short (no midpoint requirement); two-bar extreme plus0.25xcurrent hourly ATR14 stop, frozen shock-open target requiring>=1R, maximum32 bars (8h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_compression_breakout: Previous4h ATR14/close<=20th percentile of60 prior ratios excluding compression (sorted floor(.2*(n-1))); current4h close breaks prior12 highs/lows and volume>1.5xprior20 mean; 2x4h ATR14 stop, 4xATR target, maximum288 bars (72h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_slow_ema_cross: Actual completed4h EMA20/EMA100 cross, symmetric long/short; 2x4h ATR14 stop, 6xATR target, maximum672 bars (7days). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_daily_momentum: Completed-day7day and28day returns transition from non-aligned to both positive or both negative; 1.5xdaily ATR14 stop, 3xATR target, maximum672 bars (7days). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.
candidate_descriptions.r2_breakout_retest: Previous4h close breaks20-bar high/low excluding previous/current; current4h retests that edge and closes beyond it with EMA20/100 aligned; current extreme plus0.5x4h ATR14 stop, 3R target, maximum288 bars (72h). Closed-bar levels, next-15m-open entry, all UTC hours allowed. Target reward >=3 times signal-close roundtrip 0.045% fees plus 2bps slippage per side. Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.

Hourly/4h/daily indicators require 220/120/60 completed bars respectively; VWAP requires at least eight completed same-UTC-day 15m bars and a same-day previous bar.

comparisons.selected_detail_replays: Same exact selected cases are replayed for full logs; these are not new hypotheses or extra independent evidence.

selection.eligible: At baseline 5x: positive development and validation net P&L, at least 30 completed trades in EACH of development and validation. Rank eligible candidates by validation net P&L, then validation trades, then declared order.
selection.failed_fallback: If none qualifies, display highest validation net P&L with at least 30 validation trades as failed_screen_fallback, even if development has fewer than 30 trades.
selection.insufficient_sample: If none has 30 validation trades, display the highest validation net P&L with any validation trades as insufficient_sample; if none trades, select nothing.
selection.forbidden: Later periods, cost stress and continuous outcomes cannot change candidate selection or parameters.

consistency.all_periods_positive: Net P&L strictly greater than zero and at least one completed trade in every fresh-account window; breakeven and no-trade windows fail.
consistency.stress: Apply the same positivity and sample rules to all five stressed fresh-account windows.
consistency.continuous: Separately report whether every marked equity delta in one uninterrupted account is strictly positive, baseline and stress. This does not replace fresh-window sample checks.

continuous.period_accounting: Consecutive close-marked boundary equity differences, including carried positions; full-run fees/funding only.

plan.timing: Closed-candle signals, next 15m open entries, no forced midnight liquidation, maximum two entries per UTC day, at most 672 bars per position. No future rate is used to select a trade.

warmup.daily_development_first_month: No-entry warmup is retained inside the fixed development window; earliest possible daily signal is March 1 close, next entry March 2 UTC.

plan.funding: Observed signed hourly Hyperliquid rates at UTC opens for carried positions; Binance mark-open proxies unavailable oracle prices. Missing observations use adverse 0.00125%/hour; stress always adverse 0.01%/hour.
plan.liquidation: Conservative loss of remaining isolated collateral, preserving unrelated free cash. Small-notional mainnet MMR held fixed: ETH 2%, SOL 2.5%.
plan.evidence: New rules fixed before this round calculates returns. ALL periods are reused/adaptive; consistency remains retrospective, not a future-profit claim.
limitations: Research only. No wallet, order, account-permission or live leverage changes.
Binance USD-M trade and mark candles proxy Hyperliquid execution and liquidation. This is not a single-venue reconstruction.
Observed Hyperliquid funding uses Binance mark-open as an oracle-price proxy; exact historical oracle prices are unavailable.
Hourly funding is settled at the open for carried positions, before new entries. Scheduled preceding-close exits precede settlement; exact same-time matching cannot be reconstructed.
Missing funding uses an explicit adverse 0.00125% per hour for either direction; stress uses adverse 0.01% per hour.
Liquidation conservatively loses remaining isolated collateral. Actual order-book liquidation may retain some margin; no liquidation clearance fee is added.
Known open gap exits precede later mark extremes. When intrabar order is unknown, liquidation precedes stops, and stops precede targets.
Current mainnet quantity precision and small-notional maintenance tiers are held constant historically. Testnet and historical tiers can differ.
Drawdown is marked at 15-minute closes and modeled exits, not tick-by-tick. Failed stops, latency and market depth are unavailable.
Each run starts with fresh collateral and ends flat. Separate ETH/SOL runs are not a simultaneous shared-$20 portfolio.
The $20 is assumed already deposited collateral. Deposit, withdrawal, bridge, network and tax costs are excluded.
This is adaptive round-two research: every calendar period, including October 21-November 4, was examined previously. None is an untouched or prospective test.
Ten new fixed hypotheses and two assets are disclosed, with no parameter tuning or leverage search after returns. Baseline leverage is 5x throughout.
Round two permits positions across UTC midnight for up to seven days. Entries are allowed all UTC hours. This differs from the original daily-flat study.
Sizing reserves funding for at least 24 hours or the full planned holding limit, whichever is longer. Other account, risk, margin and minimum-order rules are unchanged.

Daily momentum requires 60 prior completed daily candles, but source history starts January 1, 2024 and development starts February 1. Its first development month is therefore no-entry warmup; that flat period stays in the reported development ROI. No dates are shifted or synthetic context added.
Candidate selection uses baseline development eligibility and validation ranking only. Later windows, stress and continuous outcomes cannot change selection.

Strict all-period positivity requires positive net P&L and at least one completed trade in each fresh-account window. The stronger sample screen requires 30 development, 30 validation, 20 reused-test and three trades in each short window.
A positive short window with three trades remains a small historical sample, not evidence of a durable live edge.

Fresh-window tests each start with $20 and force an evaluation-end exit. Continuous cases start once with $20 and carry account state and open positions across all five boundaries without funding or cash resets.
Continuous period changes are close-marked equity deltas including open positions. Fees and funding are reported for the full continuous run, not allocated across periods from completed trade logs.

Adverse-cost stress reruns the full strategy and sizing with 8bps slippage per fill and an adverse 0.01% hourly funding charge in either direction. Its changed sizing means it is not a fee-only subtraction from baseline trades.
USDT prices and USDC collateral are treated at dollar parity. Depeg and conversion costs are excluded alongside deposits, withdrawals, bridges, network fees and tax.
